
SASBDB entry SASDNJ2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDNJ2/)

Publication: KaiABC clock-protein complex, SEC-SAXS and cryo-EM
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-022-03143-z

Files are SASBDB downloads (sasbdb.org/media/): experimental_data/SASDNJ2.dat, SASDNJ2_fit1.fit, SASDNJ2_fit1_model1.pdb. Nothing was modified.
Buffer (phosphate, NaCl, MgCl2, EDTA, ATP, DTT, arginine, glutamine, pH 7.8), 25 C and
0.15 nm: SASBDB. The paper text read does not state the SAXS buffer (only a Tris pH 8.0
preparation buffer): a gap to be decided by the owner. The .fit has 3 columns (q, Iexp,
Ifit), header "Chi^2: 4.549" (a chi2; recomputed 4.624 with the .dat sigma). The model has no
ATP.
